text: Unfortunately, there is basically no way to telephone PIBA and get useful help :( PIBA has a central call center, but the workers there know absolutely nothing, cannot help with individual cases, and often give blatantly wrong or misleading information. Your best way to get help is to email, and if they don't answer that fairly promptly, you will need to go in person early on any weekday morning except Wednesday https://aic.org.il/contact-details-and-information-about-visa-departments-of-piba/
